initiatives.name: Record Five-Year Capital Investment Programme (2026-2031)
initiatives.summary: National Grid is committing at least £70 billion over five years (2026-2031) to modernise and expand energy networks across the UK and US Northeast. This represents the largest investment programme in the company's history, aimed at supporting economic growth, energy security and clean energy transition.

evidence.title: Record annual capital investment of £11.6 billion
evidence.summary: National Grid achieved record capital investment of £11.6 billion in 2025/26, representing an 18% increase on prior year. This investment drove asset growth of 10.9% and supports the company's strategic infrastructure modernisation programmes across all business segments.
evidence.quote: Record capital investment of £11.6 billion (2024/25: £9.8 billion), driving asset growth of 10.9% (2024/25: 9.0%)

evidence.title: £13 billion capital investment expected for 2026/27
evidence.summary: National Grid expects Group capital investment to grow around 10% to nearly £13 billion in 2026/27. This continued high level of investment will drive asset growth of around 10% and support the company's infrastructure modernisation programmes.
evidence.quote: Overall Group capital investment in 2026/27 is expected to grow around 10% to nearly £13 billion. Asset Growth is expected to be around 10%

evidence.title: Record £70 billion five-year capital investment programme
evidence.summary: National Grid is committing at least £70 billion over five years (2026-2031) to modernise and expand energy networks across the UK and US Northeast. This represents the largest investment programme in the company's history, aimed at supporting economic growth, energy security and clean energy transition.
evidence.quote: National Grid is embarking on the largest investment programme in our history, committing at least £70 billion over the next five years to modernise and expand energy networks across the UK and the US Northeast

initiatives.name: National Grid Renewables and Grain LNG Divestments
initiatives.summary: National Grid completed the sale of National Grid Renewables for £1.5 billion and Grain LNG for £1.3 billion in net cash proceeds. These divestments are part of the company's portfolio optimisation strategy to focus on core regulated network businesses.

evidence.title: Completed divestments of National Grid Renewables and Grain LNG
evidence.summary: National Grid completed the sale of National Grid Renewables for £1.5 billion and Grain LNG for £1.3 billion in net cash proceeds. These divestments are part of the company's portfolio optimisation strategy to focus on core regulated network businesses.
evidence.quote: In 2025/26, we completed the sale of our National Grid Renewables business for net cash proceeds of £1,473 million and also sold our UK Grain LNG business for net cash proceeds of £1,336 million

initiatives.name: Electricity Distribution Acquisition Synergies
initiatives.summary: National Grid delivered its three-year target of £100 million cumulative synergies from the acquisition of UK Electricity Distribution six months ahead of schedule. This represents successful integration and cost optimization from the acquisition.

evidence.title: £100 million synergies target achieved ahead of schedule

evidence.quote: We delivered our three-year target of £100 million cumulative synergies from the acquisition of UK Electricity Distribution, six months ahead of schedule

initiatives.name: Electricity Transmission Partnership
initiatives.summary: National Grid launched the Electricity Transmission Partnership to accelerate delivery of £8 billion of substation infrastructure using a regional model with strategic suppliers. This partnership strengthens supply-chain capability and creates a platform for innovation deployment at scale across the RIIO-T3 price control period.

evidence.title: Electricity Transmission Partnership for substation infrastructure

This partnership strengthens supply-chain capability and creates a platform for innovation deployment at scale across the RIIO-T3 price control period.
evidence.quote: Launched the Electricity Transmission Partnership to accelerate the delivery of £8 billion of substation infrastructure by adopting a regional model with a number of strategic suppliers across the RIIO-T3 price control

initiatives.name: US CLCPA Supply Chain Infrastructure Investment
initiatives.summary: National Grid secured supply chain partners to support over $3 billion of capital investment in New England electricity networks and executed construction contracts for $3.5 billion CLCPA projects in New York. These agreements cover the next five years and represent more than $6.5 billion of total committed investment.

evidence.title: Supply chain partnerships for $6.5 billion US investment

These agreements cover the next five years and represent more than $6.5 billion of total committed investment.
evidence.quote: Agreed supply chain partners to support over $3 billion of capital investment in electricity networks in New England across the next five years. Executed construction and commercial contracts for our Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act (CLCPA) Phase 1 and 2 projects in New York, representing more than $3.5 billion of investment

initiatives.name: Great Grid Partnership for ASTI Wave 2
initiatives.summary: National Grid launched the Great Grid Partnership with seven strategic partners to deliver nine major infrastructure projects across England and Wales. This partnership will cover design, consenting services and construction for Wave 2 ASTI onshore projects.

initiatives.name: AI Growth Zones Network Support
initiatives.summary: National Grid supported the UK Government in developing AI Growth Zones by providing early network insight for site identification and feasibility studies. The RIIO-T3 investment plan is expected to deliver 10 GW capacity to enable over 30 data centre connections, with four zones targeting 500 MW of AI-ready data centre capacity each by 2030.

evidence.title: AI Growth Zones network infrastructure support
evidence.summary: National Grid supported the UK Government in developing AI Growth Zones by providing early network insight for site identification and feasibility studies. The RIIO-T3 investment plan is expected to deliver 10 GW capacity to enable over 30 data centre connections, with four zones targeting 500 MW of AI-ready data centre capacity each by 2030.
evidence.quote: We supported the UK Government in its development of AI Growth Zones, providing early network insight to inform site identification, and feasibility, with four zones now announced each targeting 500 MW of AI-ready data centre capacity by 2030. Overall, our RIIO-T3 investment plan is expected to deliver 19 GW of additional demand capacity, including 10 GW to enable over 30 data centre connections to the system
